mostWorthwhile.text: Measuring both operating radios against their reserves was worthwhile: it gave the overnight claim a concrete basis and included a margin and a follow-up check.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the meter before the link was running was unproductive; the failure did not explain the required setup order.

surprise.text: The meter could not be used until after the reserves and controller were connected, despite the radios already being mounted.

arbitrary.text: The delayed availability of the meter felt somewhat arbitrary because the initial failure gave no explanation for it.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see how the neighbors make their networks understand each other, especially after establishing a working local link.
